summary: Cellebrite DI Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing that Shiven Ramji, who joined as President of Products and Technology in May 2026, has succeeded Thomas E. Hogan as CEO, effective immediately, as part of a planned transition. Ramji will also join the board. Hogan, who had served as Executive Chairman, interim CEO, and then CEO, will depart. The company also released Q2 2026 results, lowering full-year ARR and revenue guidance while raising adjusted EBITDA target. No deal terms or financial transaction are involved. The event is a planned, orderly executive succession rather than a forced departure, but the CEO transition itself is the filing's primary event.
